annotations.text:
House style held: #045AA9 blue, #D50057 accent used only for urgency and warnings, #2A2A2A body, white ground.

Type maps to the Word deliverable: Archivo falls back to Aptos Display / Segoe UI Semibold, Figtree falls back to Aptos / Calibri. So the .docx and .pdf reproduce this layout with the house fonts.
The accent chip above each artboard swaps the pink across every place it appears: the rule under the masthead, the deadline strip, the warning icons, the signature callout.
